# Capture plan

- A01/A02/A03/A04: centred, approximately 0.40/0.55/0.75/1.00 m.
- B01/B02/B03: upper-left/upper-centre/upper-right.
- B04/B05: middle-left/middle-right.
- B06/B07/B08: lower-left/lower-centre/lower-right.
- C01/C02: left perspective about 20° / 30–35°.
- C03/C04: right perspective about 20° / 30–35°.
- C05/C06: high-down / low-up about 20°.
- C07/C08: opposite two-axis compound tilts.

Each pose uses one existing formal 11-frame scan while the rigid Camera+ToF assembly is stationary. Active board stays fully visible. Full instructions are in `CAPTURE_GUIDE_STAGE2A.md` in the workspace.
